en: Wow, you came all the way here?\nMaybe you're a POKéMANIAC, too?\lWant to see my collection?
I have more rare POKéMON at home!
Hi, kid!\nWant to see my POKéMON?
I don't like you.\nI don't like anyone better than me!
I've been out at a POKéMON GYM\na few times.\p…But I always lose.
I noticed some POKéMANIACS\nprowling around.\pCan you imagine? Them?\nUp here in the mountains?
I feel bloated on mountain air!
I'm feeling a bit faint.\nI haven't hiked in some time.
I'm too tired.\nI wasn't up for it.
The POKéMON here in the mountains\nare so chunky…\pI wish there were pink POKéMON\nwith a floral pattern!
